In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Viqi Shesh]] organized a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''assassination attempt''' against [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Borsk Fey'lya]]. It occurred during the unveiling of the [[YVH-Series battle droid]] by [[Tendrando Arms]], though the [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] were defeated by members of Fey'lya's party, with the aid of [[YVH 1]].
